cards.name: Hallowed Haunting
cards.oracle_text:
As long as you control seven or more enchantments, creatures you control have flying and vigilance.
Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, create a white Spirit Cleric creature token with "This token's power and toughness are each equal to the number of Spirits you control."

cards.name: Soul Warden
cards.oracle_text: Whenever another creature enters, you gain 1 life.
cards.flavor_text: The group called the Benefactors offers what aid and protection it can to other survivors, marking precious safe zones with the sign of the flame.

cards.name: Expropriate
cards.oracle_text: Council's dilemma — Starting with you, each player votes for time or money. For each time vote, take an extra turn after this one. For each money vote, choose a permanent owned by the voter and gain control of it. Exile Expropriate.
cards.flavor_text: Even those who think they have nothing have something left to lose.

cards.name: Phantasmal Image
cards.oracle_text: You may have this creature enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it's an Illusion in addition to its other types and it has "When this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability, sacrifice it."

cards.name: Damnation
cards.oracle_text: Destroy all creatures. They can't be regenerated.
cards.flavor_text: Bound to a single house, Valgavoth simply expanded its boundaries until it consumed the plane, turning a vibrant world into his playground of terror.

cards.name: Sacrifice
cards.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
Add an amount of {B} equal to the sacrificed creature's mana value.
cards.flavor_text: Cultists eagerly undergo the Rite of the Threshold, allowing Valgavoth to feed on their fear and bind them to the essence of the House.

cards.name: Maddening Hex
cards.oracle_text:
Enchant player
Whenever enchanted player casts a noncreature spell, roll a d6. This Aura deals damage to that player equal to the result. Then attach this Aura to another one of your opponents chosen at random.

cards.name: Unholy Heat
cards.oracle_text:
Unholy Heat deals 2 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
Delirium — Unholy Heat deals 6 damage instead if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
cards.flavor_text: He turns every room into a crematorium.

cards.name: Collected Company
cards.oracle_text: Look at the top six cards of your library. Put up to two creature cards with mana value 3 or less from among them onto the battlefield. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
cards.flavor_text: Survivors who stay together, slay together.

cards.name: Noxious Revival
cards.oracle_text:
({G/P} can be paid with either {G} or 2 life.)
Put target card from a graveyard on top of its owner's library.
cards.flavor_text:
"Nothing I beat down stays down. I love this place!"
—Tyvar
